HEEWON STYLE: Korean WEBTOON figures in watercolor-and-oil world, minimal iconic layout, movie tenebrism. Night ground BLACK. Thick ink line. Magenta #D8258C = real wet/lamp specular NOT glow. Composed for 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at top or bottom edge. No text. No watermark. Not photoreal. Painterly anime-adjacent cinema. HIGH three-quarter / near bird’s-eye. SET: Tsushima strait, night storm. One Silla hull: cream sail, blue crescent. Black water, rain spears, lightning as the only hard white. Chunchu in soaking magenta. LAYOUT: Near-monochrome inverted flash: white lightning blanks the sky; tiny Silla hull (cream sail, blue crescent) a toy on black water, lower third. Chunchu a magenta speck at the rail. Monumental emptiness + one flash. EFFECTS: inverted flash, rain needles. MANGA ACTION FRAME: a single seinen historical-manga action panel painted in ink and oil — bold dry-brush sumi-ink SPEED LINES streaking along the direction of motion, radial FOCUS LINES converging on the face or the blade, motion smears on legs, mane, cloth and steel, flung ink-splatter dirt and dust, extreme foreshortening and a hard dutch tilt so the frame itself feels like it is moving; heavy black ink masses against a few hard highlights, one gold accent. Faces stay clean webtoon ink line with fierce narrowed eyes. Full-bleed single frame: NO panel borders, NO speech bubbles, NO onomatopoeia or sound-effect lettering, NO text of any kind. Faces ONLY from the attached sheet by position (LEFT to RIGHT as listed in the sheet). Invent new dramatic bodies — never portrait stance clones.
